This is due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping in the acym_cleanVar() sanitizer…

Firefox for iOS could autofill saved credentials into a new page if cross-origin navigation occurred while the saved-login UI was open. Autofill was not bound to the originating page or rejected when its origin changed. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox for iOS 157.1.

Firefox for iOS directly interpolated the page’s HTML language attribute into translation JavaScript, allowing attacker-controlled markup to execute code in Firefox’s privileged content world and bypass the page’s Content Security Policy. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox for iOS 157.1.
